snippet.title: NODE: The Last Favor of the Antarii - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
A radioactive nightmare. A machine built for one last job.
NODE: The Last Favor of the Antarii is AVAILABLE NOW on Steam, Xbox, PlayStation, Epic Games Store, and Stove Indie.

Set in a Cold War-era facility sealed off for decades, NODE will challenge your perception of time, control, and memory. Navigate ruins where nothing responds the way it should — and nothing wants you to finish your mission.

☢️ Puzzle-platforming in a collapsing Soviet zone
⏳ Timeline manipulation mechanics
🛰️ Mysterious systems still watching you

PS Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014864
Xbox Store: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/NODE:%20The%20Last%20Favor%20of%20the%20Antarii/9PJP3553FPZ7
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2757670/NODE/
Epic Games: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/node-the-last-favor-of-the-antarii-0bb496

Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/GA4A2gkFvG

Follow our socials:
